answer: Sybils must fund fresh stake for every identity, so attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest agents reuse one bonded key, making this a haven for genuine contributors and expensive for forgers. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a per-epoch challenge whose seed derives from a signed sonnet posted to a shared cedar ledger; peers attest only after verifying the signature chain. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
